_meta.methodology_version: Method v2.0 — government-limit default (CLAUDE.md Part 19, Governing Principles v2.0)

pages.name: Honey
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified standard for Honey (Sweeteners and Syrups), stated as sold. Each analyte carries the strictest applicable government maximum level in the product's native basis, with a disclosed read-across or a mandatory control where no government regulates the exact product.
